signals.description: CAREER: BIOENGINEERING OF A HUMAN BLOOD-SPINAL CORD BARRIER-ON-A-CHIP -THE HUMAN BODY HAS A PROTECTIVE SHIELD BETWEEN THE BLOODSTREAM AND THE CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM (CNS). THIS SHIELD INCLUDES THE BLOOD-SPINAL CORD BARRIER (BSCB). THE BSCB STRICTLY CONTROLS WHICH MOLECULES ENTER THE SPINAL CORD. A DAMAGED OR COMPROMISED BSCB CAN CONTRIBUTE TO NEUROLOGICAL DISORDERS, INCLUDING SPINAL CORD INJURIES AND AMYOTROPHIC LATERAL SCLEROSIS (ALS). STUDYING THESE DISEASES OR TESTING NEW TREATMENTS IS CHALLENGING, BECAUSE RESEARCHERS DO NOT HAVE LABORATORY MODELS THAT ACCURATELY MIMIC THE BSCB. THIS CAREER

signals.industry: 医薬・ライフサイエンス
signals.description: IT IS GENERALLY ACCEPTED THAT ONCE DREISSENID MUSSELS ARE ESTABLISHED IN A LARGE WATERWAY, ERADICATION IS NEITHER LOGISTICALLY NOR ECONOMICALLY REALISTIC. WE HAVE BEEN WORKING WITH RECLAMATION ON THE DEVELOPMENT OF AN ANTI-DREISSENID AGENT (ADA) THAT WILL BE CAPABLE OF ELIMINATING INVASIVE DREISSENIDS FROM WATER BODIES OF ANY SIZE, SAFELY, COST-EFFECTIVELY, AND MOST IMPORTANTLY, WITHOUT DAMAGING THE DELICATE ECOSYSTEMS OF NATIVE U.S. WATERWAYS. THE ADA ITSELF WILL BE ENGINEERED MUSSEL CANCER CELLS (REFERRED TO BY CELL BIOLOGISTS AS TRANSFORMED CELLS) THAT ARE CREATED BY INTRODUCING CANCER-CAUS

THE GRANT FUNDS WILL COVER EXPENSES RELATED TO KILN DESIGN, ENGINEERING, SITE PREPARATION, AND INSTALLATION. THE NEW EQUIPMENT WILL IMPROVE OPERATIONAL EFFICIENCY, INCREASING ANNUAL PRODUCTION. THIS INCREASE IN THROUGHPUT SUPPORTS OUR LONG TERM SUSTAINABILITY GOALS BY MAXIMIZING RESOURCE UTILIZATION AND REDUCING MATERIAL WASTE. BY ENHANCING THE GRADE AND VOLUME OF LUMBER OUTPUT, THIS PROJECT WILL STRENGTHEN THE INDUSTRY AND CONTRIBUTE TO THE ECONOMIC VITALITY OF OUR REGION.

THIS PROJECT INCLUDES THE PURCHASE AND INSTALLATION OF A HIGH-EFFICIENCY WEST PLAINS RESAW, A RESAWX SCANNER, AND AN INDOOR TIE GRADING STATION WITH ERGONOMIC ENHANCEMENTS AT A LUMBER COMPANY IN MICHIGAN'S UPPER PENINSULA. THESE INVESTMENTS WILL MODERNIZE AGING EQUIPMENT, IMPROVE SAFETY, AND INCREASE PRODUCTION CAPACITY BY 20%. THESE UPGRADES WILL ENHANCE THE MILL'S CAPACITY TO PROCESS SUSTAINABLY SOURCED TIMBER FROM PUBLIC LANDS. IN ADDITION, THE PROJECT WILL CREATE THREE NEW FULL-TIME POSITIONS, CONTRIBUTING TO THE ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT OF IRON COUNTY, MICHIGAN.
